            # A at all columns EXCEPT odd columns 1, 3, 5, ... up to col 2*(i//2)+1

            is_excluded = (j >= 1) and (j % 2 == 1) and (j < max_odd)

            max_even = 2 * (i // 2 + 1) - 1  # This is inclusive upper bound
